title: Association-oriented initiate request with safe CR TPDU-size option
purpose: Exercise early RFC1006/COTP parsing and MMS initiate entry while preserving a safe structural analogue of the TPDU-size option path referenced by the enabled issue.

messages.label: COTP Connection Request with valid TPDU-size code and minimal Initiate-Request-PDU

expected_behavior: Parser accepts the TPKT/COTP framing, processes the CR variable part without undefined shift behavior, and reaches the MMS Initiate-Request-PDU entry path without crashing.
constraints_preserved: TPKT total-length field matches the full message length 0x0019
TPDU-size option 0xC0 uses parameterLen 0x01 with a safe code 0x0a instead of the historical invalid shift exponent payload
MMS PDU tag 0xA8 is used for Initiate-Request-PDU per supplied catalog
All hex strings are even-length lowercase with no separators
issue_safety_notes: Safe structural analogue only: retains the C0/01 TPDU-size parsing shape from issue 589 but replaces the crashing attacker-controlled code with a conservative valid value and does not reuse the exact historical payload.
